Method of Attack: Remote Access Trojan (RAT) with capabilities including collecting system data, logging keystrokes, taking screenshots, propagating via removable USB devices, and communicating with C2 servers using uncommon HTTP status codes to bypass detection
Attack Vector: Visa-related application stored on a shared local network directory
Indicators of Compromise: Command and Control (C2) servers using rare HTTP/HTTPS status codes as per IETF RFC 7231, 6585, 4918
